prompt.generated_prompt_string: A clearly adult woman at a fictional international film festival gala, with copper-red loose voluminous waves just past the shoulders, bold matte red lipstick, subtle blue-eye makeup, warm realistic skin texture, and a confident poised expression. She wears a custom strapless floor-length black velvet gown with a structured architectural bodice, lined geometric cutout details, and elegant sculptural construction, plus silver drop earrings and restrained rings. Use a vibrant red fictional festival press wall with an abstract white event emblem and no real festival or beauty branding. Bright even event flash creates clean highlights on velvet, hair, jewelry, and facial structure with soft background separation. Capture a vertical 4:5 medium-full portrait using an 85mm event lens, realistic material texture, controlled highlights, and subtle grain in a gothic Hollywood glamour style.
